column1: # Packages per distro family, read by install.sh.
# Columns (tab separated): key, profile, arch, debian, fedora, openbsd.
# OpenBSD has no Hyprland nor Quickshell yet: only the apps and their themes.
# profile: core = always installed, full = only with --profile full.
# "-" = not in the official repositories; "a|b" = first available name;
# several packages in one cell are separated by spaces.
# The installer checks every name before installing and skips missing ones.
# Game mode asks Feral GameMode for its optimisations (CPU in performance).
# Power saver mode (powerprofilesctl); recent Fedora ships tuned-ppd for it.
# Night mode's warmer screen; not packaged on Fedora (night mode only dims).
# The login screen (Qt 6 greeter); Debian ships the QtQuick.Effects module apart.
